acceptanceCriteria: A fix task is judged by its own history entry whatever newer entries the range holds
A fix task whose own entry lacks a Bug row still fails closed
diagnosis: Reproduced: ci verify on a two-commit range (a fix whose entry carries Bug, then a docs change whose entry is newest in the same file) reports core/bug-registry 'fix task names no bug row'. Root cause: bugRegistryReal judges every fix task against newestBugField, which reads entries[0] of the first history file in ascending path order, so it reads the newest entry of the OLDEST file and ignores which task the entry belongs to; historyFallback has the same oldest-file pick. Same union-scope class as BUG-0083. Fix: match each fix task to the entry whose Task field equals the task id, searching history files newest first, and fall back to the newest entry only when none names the task.
